title: Trajectory arclength reveals chaos
summary: In this paper, we investigate the time-averaged phase space arclength of a trajectory, expressed through a normalized Lagrangian descriptor, as a trajectory-based diagnostic for distinguishing regular and chaotic dynamics. The proposed indicator, $Ω$, is computed by integrating the equations of motion together with a single scalar arclength-accumulation equation and therefore does not require variational equations, neighboring trajectories, or spatial derivatives of a Lagrangian descriptor field.
